evidence: The recommendation logically follows from the documented findings across all read sources. Using an OpenAI-compatible route defaulting to OpenRouter (option 1) while permitting direct native endpoints is justified because OpenRouter normalizes schemas across vendor-prefixed models [A1], whereas Gemini's compatibility layer is beta [A2], Anthropic's is for testing only [A3], and DeepSeek [A4] and Moonshot [A5] support the shape natively. Relying on prompt-based JSON with tolerant parsing and a fail-closed local check (option 4) rather than strict json_schema (option 3) holds up because OpenRouter schema support varies by endpoint and may only act as a hint [B2], unsupported parameters are silently ignored unless provider.require_parameters is set [A1][B3], truncation breaks repair [B4], and callers must handle refusals and incomplete responses regardless [B1]. Requiring a validator from a different model family with single-dossier evaluation is grounded in findings on self-preference (+10% for GPT-4, +25% for Claude-v1) and position bias [B5], alongside linear correlation between self-recognition and self-preference [B6]. Finally, the refutation criteria establish concrete, falsifiable tests (>10% parse failure rate across 6 dossiers, and a planted error test).
